changes_in_this_commit: Renamed claude-api to llm-api-sdk (reserved name words). Updated marketplace.json, the SKILL.md body and the language folders.
Shortened the llm-api-sdk description from 1,068 to 1,015 characters.
Replaced placeholder emails jane@co.com and john@co.com with example.com addresses.
llm-api-sdk: drop_block_probe.py rejects non-http(s) base URLs before urlopen.
Added a '# Title' heading to algorithmic-art, canvas-design and internal-comms.
collection_findings: All 19 skill descriptions together total about 9,384 characters. Claude Code's skill listing fits about 8,000 characters and Codex's about the same, so descriptions are shortened when the whole folder loads together. This is why most skills show 2 of 6 harnesses degraded. Import in groups, or shorten descriptions.

Security flags of the form 'analysis-evasion (partial)' mean the scanner's static parser could not resolve a referenced file. The scanner's own suggestion is to fix the scanner, not the content. They are not evidence of malicious content.
regenerate: cd SkillEvaluator && uv run --python 3.13 skillevaluator quality-check <skill-dir> -r cli -r json -o <out>
cd SkillEvaluator && uv run --python 3.13 skillevaluator validate <skill-dir> --tiers 1 --no-llm -o <out>
cd SkillEvaluator && uv run --python 3.13 skillevaluator harness-check <skill-dir>
